title: Grateful Dead Live at Memorial Auditorium on 1972-08-12
lineage: Akai GX636 direct tape head output  > Bottlehead tube tape pre w/ a pair of Telefunken tubes circa 1960  > Apogee Mini Me 24/96  > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering  > FLAC
source: master reel @7.5ips> J.Garcia's reel @ 3.75ips > Will Boswell's reel @ 3.75ips

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy show featuring a standout “Big Railroad” performance, though the separate tuning tracks are a minor annoyance.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its warm tube‑driven clarity and overall consistency that kicks off four months of strong touring. Fans highlight the electric version of “Big Railroad” as a top‑tier rendition, while one reviewer notes the inconvenience of having each tuning track split from the songs. Aside from that edit quirk, the show is regarded as consistently powerful.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers commend the musical performance and sound quality, giving a high rating overall; however one reviewer gave a zero‑star rating due to editing annoyances, creating mixed sentiment and limiting confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm tube‑enhanced sound, crisp mix, but tuning tracks are separated from the songs, which some listeners find annoying.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, consistent opening of a touring stretch; set flows well with high‑energy delivery throughout.
